2f34d7337d98 (""workqueue: Fix queue_work_on() with BH workqueues"") added
irq_work usage to workqueue; however
column2: it turns out irq_work is actually

column1: optional and the change breaks build on configuration which doesn't have
CONFIG_IRQ_WORK enabled.
Fix build by making workqueue use irq_work only when CONFIG_SMP and enabling
CONFIG_IRQ_WORK when CONFIG_SMP is set. It's reasonable to argue that it may
be better to just always enable it. However
column2: this still saves a small bit of

column1: memory for tiny UP configs and also the least amount of change
let's keep it conditional.
Verified to do the right thing for x86_64 allnoconfig and defconfig
aarch64 allnoconfig
column2: allnoconfig + prink disable (SMP but nothing selects

column1: IRQ_WORK) and a modified aarch64 Kconfig where !SMP and nothing selects
IRQ_WORK.
v2: `depends on SMP` leads to Kconfig warnings when CONFIG_IRQ_WORK is
selected by something else when !CONFIG_SMP. Use `def_bool y if SMP`
instead.
